card.name: Words just before a question mark
card.fires_on: Mixed words in running text where a question is likely to come next, such as "The" after a bullet of a question list, or "in" after "suicidal thoughts and behavior". It is weak and scattered.

modes.label: Question lists
modes.description: A word starting or continuing a line in a list of web questions or forum prompts.

modes.description: The word "in" after suicidal thoughts and behavior in the antidepressant warning.

card.writes: It promotes question marks and line breaks after them, so it pushes the text toward ending a question.
card.plain: It fires on ordinary words where the text may turn into a question and nudges the model toward a question mark.
